To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the maximum entropy formalism is a useful framework for modelling cell-to-cell variability in continuous cell cultures, and that heterogeneity can have significant impact on the dynamics of such systems.
maximum entropy models can capture the heterogeneity of continuous cell cultures and can provide a more realistic description of the system.

(1) The population of cells in a continuous culture is heterogeneous, (2) the distribution of cells can be approximated by a maximum entropy distribution, (3) this approach allows to compute the stationary state and the dynamical landscape in the chemostat, (4) the distribution of phenotypes can be used to compute the population size, (5) the presence of heterogeneity leads to qualitatively different dynamics and to larger population sizes.
